extracted.intended_audience: EPA Office of Public Affairs staff, EPA communicators, and contractors producing EPA communications (press releases, web content, graphics, logos)
extracted.subtask_description: Organization-specific style and production guidance for EPA communications products, covering writing, graphics, logos, and a product-development checklist; intended to be followed by EPA communicators and contractors producing public-facing materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conformance to this Stylebook
rubrics_metrics.description: All communications products must conform to the guidance included in this edition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA's Office of Public Affairs developed this Stylebook in 2008 and published it in early 2009. OPA has no plans to update this Stylebook. This edition is the mandatory reference for EPA communications products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fallback authoritative references
rubrics_metrics.description: For topics or rules not addressed by this Stylebook, consult the AP Stylebook first, and the U.S. Government Printing Office Style Manual second.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the EPA Stylebook is silent on a question of usage, format, or style, users should rely on AP style as the first external authority and the GPO Style Manual as the secondary external authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for Product Development
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A prescribed checklist of nine steps governs the development and publication workflow for communications products (used to ensure consistency, review, clearance, and readiness for release).

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Guide (grammar and usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grammar, punctuation, spelling, vocabulary, syntax and usage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Writing Guide provides the agency's standards on grammatical construction, punctuation, spelling conventions, word choice, sentence structure, and other usage issues for all EPA written communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphics Guide (production and print requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Color vs. black and white, printing requirements, paper stocks, use of government bankcard, and more!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Graphics Guide specifies visual/production standards for EPA materials, including when to use color or black-and-white, required printing specifications, approved paper stocks, permissible procurement/payment methods (e.g., government bankcard), and other graphic-production considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo Guide (EPA seal and logo usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA logo usage and policies; Using the EPA seal and logo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Logo Guide lays out policies and permitted uses for the EPA seal and logo, including rules governing placement, sizing, reproduction, and any restrictions on use in communications products.
